request: Live workflow orchestration test using a public Bacillus subtilis 168 dataset, accession DRR000852. The input files are uploads/DRR000852_subset_R1.fastq.gz and uploads/DRR000852_subset_R2.fastq.gz. Use pipeline_specialist to inspect the catalog and prepare one saved multi-pipeline workflow. Perform read quality control, assemble the cleaned paired reads, generate a MetaX taxonomic profile from the cleaned paired reads, and annotate transport-related functions from the assembled contigs using TCDB genome annotation. Finally summarize the actual results and output files. Infer and save explicit upstream-output input links. Assembly and taxonomic profiling can run independently after QC, while annotation must consume the assembly. Use the installed deployment databases and images. Use genome_context=metagenome for fragmentary contigs. Save the workflow and request approval before execution. Return IDs and progress when started so the application runtime can monitor execution. Do not substitute bundled demo files. Do not run unrelated analysis or modify existing MSCAN records.
